data.one_liner: Tabler Icons icon font with typed IconData constants for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides over 6,300 open-source Tabler Icons as typed IconData constants for Flutter apps. The icons are fully compatible with the standard Icon widget and theme system.
use_when: You need a vast set of clean outline and filled icons in your Flutter application
You want drop-in compatibility with the standard Icon widget
avoid_when: You only need a tiny handful of icons and want to minimize app bundle size with custom SVGs
strengths: Automatically synced and updated with new Tabler Icons releases
Fully compatible with Flutter's Icon widget and themes
weaknesses: Large icon font package which may increase app size if only a few icons are used

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Font Awesome icon set instead of Tabler Icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Lucide icon set.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Google's Material Symbols.
